An '''unidentified Imperial officer''' were assigned to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader's]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In 0 ABY, shorty after the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], the [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Void Station)|officer]] came with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] on his visit to [[Void Station]]. When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] returned to the [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]], he quickly asked if Vader was all right, as his [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armor]] was damaged. The only response he received was an order to prepare the ship for take-off.
